    COMP price performance

    Over the past year, Compound has fallen 42.7%. Its daily closes ranged from $15.190 (June 30, 2026) to $35.800 (December 2, 2025) over the last 52 weeks. On November 7, 2026 it closed at $19.930, 44.3% below that high, with 30-day annualized volatility of 94.5%. Its best full month was Apr 2026 (+33.81%) and its worst was Dec 2025 (-29.57%). Over the last 90 days its daily moves had a correlation of 0.51 with Bitcoin's (loosely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep). Its largest fall between daily closes within the year was 57.6%, from December 2, 2025 to June 30, 2026.     About Compound
